case_title: JOHN MCGARY VS. DANIEL CHRISTOPHER SHUPP

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY MCGARY, JOHN AS TO DEFENDANT SHUPP, DANIEL CHRISTOPHER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-03-2021 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $40.00 - SERVED OCT-26-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT SHUPP, DANIEL CHRISTOPHER

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-03-2021 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO JUL-01-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JOHN MCGARY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DANIEL CHRISTOPHER SHUPP IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF (SEE NOTES). (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2021 - CONTINUED ON THE COURTS OWN MOTION TO DEC-02-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. MATTER IS NOT RIPE. PLAINTIFF JOHN MCGARY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DANIEL CHRISTOPHER SHUPP IS NOT PRESENT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE TO DECEMBER 2, 2021 AT 1:30 P.M. DEPT. 506. ISSUE IS NOT RIPE.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF JOHN MCGARY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DANIEL CHRISTOPHER SHUPP IS NOT PRESENT. THE COURT INFORMS THE PLAINTIFF THAT HIS CASE CANNOT BE HEARD WITHOUT THE PROPER CLAIM FILED (SC-500), AND WITH THE ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS OF THAT FORM MET. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE, PLAINTIFF MUST REFILE
